summary: Frontend-only visual-upgrade verification for Velora bilingual landing page. Executed Playwright on desktop (1920) with responsive checks at 375 & 768. All 15 feature groups from the review request pass: age gate (shows on first visit, age-confirm-btn hides modal and sets localStorage velora_age=1); Hero (title, hero-download-btn, hero-chip-0..2 visible, hero-phone-main present); Navbar scroll-progress-bar grows from matrix(0,...) to matrix(0.9896,...) between top and bottom of page; Stats count-up end values exactly '0', '4K', '85%', '8.0+'; Features bento 6 tiles all present with feature-creator-cta href=#creator-hub; Premium shows $9.99 and gold badge chip; Roadmap 4 items; Screens tabs switch phones (tab-1 shows phone-1 and hides phone-0, back works); How it works 3 steps + how-console + how-download-btn opens apk-download-modal with modal-status-ready and modal-download-link href = https://xwsghmvyuzojnpmpvrya.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/updates/velora_v0.11.0.apk, modal-close-btn closes; Compare popular badge + 9 rows + premium column $9.99/month; Safety 6 items; FAQ click q1 opens a1 and closes a0; final-cta-download-btn opens modal; Language toggle: ES shows 'MÁS POPULAR', EN shows 'MOST POPULAR'; Responsive: scrollWidth==clientWidth at both 375 and 768 (no horizontal overflow); 0 console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Review request references data-testid 'age-gate-confirm' but actual attribute in AgeGate.jsx is 'age-confirm-btn' — consider aligning naming conventions (either update tests or component) for consistency.

AgeGate component mounts via useEffect-driven state after localStorage check — gate visibly flashes/paints after initial render. Consider gating initial render via useLayoutEffect or SSR-safe initial state to avoid FOUC on real users.
i18n.js remains 500+ lines (prior comment carried over); split EN/ES locales into separate modules for maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features from review request pass. Note: AgeGate confirm button testid is 'age-confirm-btn' (not 'age-gate-confirm' as hinted in request). Use page.add_init_script to preset localStorage velora_age=1 to skip gate during repeat visits. Scroll progress bar observed via computed transform of [data-testid=scroll-progress-bar]. No console errors, no horizontal overflow at any breakpoint. APK v0.11.0 modal link verified to supabase storage URL as specified.
